verdict.rationale: Evidence only shows that external AI agents can control Viam machines via the SDK/CLI/shell (viam-docs-12, viam-docs-31, viam-docs-32) — this is the reverse direction (an agent driving Viam), not a built-in assistant inside the Viam product that a user can delegate tasks to. No evidence of an in-app AI assistant/copilot for configuring machines, writing modules, or querying data.
